gate_sequence: Contract preparation only at selected base14721aaeed6a5f1c5c2190f264e5ba78679472ba; dependency127 is captured complete in selection.json. Pending main CI38565810273 is an implementation prerequisite, not a preparation prerequisite.

Independent Validator Mode A and Evaluator contract review approve the same proposed contract with approved:true and all three issue arrays empty; only Root promotes approved status. Root verifies actual successful main CI before implementation.

After approval, independent author supplies small aggregate and concrete controls; distinct reviewer seals/reviews complete acceptance bundle and exercised identities before Generator documentation implementation. No Generator acceptance edits.

Independent Mode B checks full scoped diff, role ownership, preservation, required deliverables and actual counted cost before distinct fresh QA executes the exact three commands and its additional adversarial check on a committed candidate.

Actual existing hosted CI executes unchanged fourteen-command harness against the new runner identity. Its command/exit receipt is separate from fresh QA core-ready receipt; hosted harness does not acquire a core-ready claim.

Root verifies every required receipt exists with actual command/output/exit/source/test/environment and QA references, binds candidate identity across QA/CI, captures partial-core evidence, then alone completes128/canonical phase and lifecycle. Planner may project that captured current state.

budget.rule: Preserve original accounting; charge all preparation/product/tests/process once, including optional projections and controls. No new allowance or rebaseline; Root measures actuals and escalates scope/budget mismatch before expansion.

evidence_convention: Role-owned named stdout/stderr/result files record actual argv/cwd/environment/exit/exercised revision and source/test hashes; seals/verdicts reference immutable paths/Git objects. contract1-* is Generator-owned preparation only; other roles use their attributed names. Fresh adversarial evidence is .agent/evidence/128-qa-adversarial.txt. No recursive evidence copies.
